schema.paired_centered_angle_deg: angle minus this method mean on common support; empty outside common support

limitations: This audits saved offline software video outputs, not the October2026 FPGA image or live FPGA stabilization.
The matched support means same zero-based encoded video index and detected markerID15; no source exposure identity, physical timestamp, or dropped/repeated-frame audit is established.

Angle population STD is dispersion around each method's own sample mean. Constant mounting bias is removed; absolute gravity accuracy, calibrated roll error, pitch error, and sensor/display latency are not measured.
No surveyed marker mounting angle, calibrated plane pose, per-corner covariance, reprojection residual, or independent attitude trace is provided for this metric.
Current default DetectorParameters.cornerRefinementMethod=0 (CORNER_REFINE_NONE); archive's subpixel claim is not supported by the executed code.

Archive code takes the first detected marker withoutID filtering. The audit found onlyID15 and no multiple-marker frame in both tested intervals, so this defect does not alter these reproduced numbers.
Archive's100% detection wording rounds rates to whole percent; raw/stabilized each miss one different frame in30-45s.
Angles are folded modulo90 to[-45,45); this is not an unrestricted angle metric. Observed values did not approach its branch boundary in the audited windows.

No generation command or settings manifest ties specific beta, smoothing, offset, or upstream raw hashes to the threecam3_in files. A compatible configurable generator exists; gen_log/of_log describe different2534x540four-camera outputs.
Camera exclusion rationale exists only as compile_stab_excel.py prose: first3cameras(cam0-2),cam3 slightlydesynced. No quantified offset or exclusion-selection record was found.
These two intervals are selected examples, not an independently prespecified or held-out test set; find_segment.py explicitly supports selecting15s windows by image/IMU behavior.

Root aruco CSVs have1200rows and distinct numbers, unlike1800-frame30fpscam3_in files. Present root two-camera videos fail to detect a marker at sampled frames where CSVs reportone; direct video-to-CSV provenance is unresolved.
Temporal correlation prevents treating the frame count as independent trials. No confidence interval or inferential significance is claimed.
Checkerboard detector was source-inspected but not recomputed; other metricsJSONs and rootCSV statistics were read/summarized, not all recomputed from video.
